name: ICDAR 2015 Incidental Scene Text Dataset
description: A dataset of incidental scene text images used in ICDAR 2015 Robust Reading Competition Challenge 4, covering text localisation, word recognition, and end-to-end recognition.
citation: Karatzas, D., Gomez-Bigorda, L., Nicolaou, A., Ghosh, S., Bagdanov, A., Iwamura, M., Matas, J., Neumann, L., Chandrasekhar, V. R., Lu, S., Shafait, F., Uchida, S., & Valveny, E. (2015). ICDAR 2015 competition on Robust Reading. 2015 13th International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR), 1156–1160. https://doi.org/10.1109/ICDAR.2015.7333942
